status: RosettaCodeData fetched into training; other sources remain proposals
measurement_notes: Remote measurements stream pinned GitHub archives and count strict UTF-8 raw lines, including tests and generated files; archives may omit files and are not corpus-lock measurements.
Generic suffix-based screening includes false positives and is not a language-qualified gain estimate.
Rosetta and Linguist label counts use reviewed per-directory associations instead of filename-only classification. These are source fragments, not verified buildable programs.
Local grammar counts describe current checkouts and approximate test-header counts. selected_sha is a selection pin, not verification that a locally edited checkout matches it.
No combined closure number is claimed: dataset copies, aliases, mixed-language wrappers and expected-error cases must be deduplicated and classified before import.
